title: PM Delegates Codebase Recon to Scout Before Planning
description: Before drafting a plan, the PM must understand the existing codebase layout. The PM is expected to delegate read-only reconnaissance to the scout_probe sub-agent rather than hand-rolling broad exploration, then summarize the scope it learned. Probes that PM uses scout_probe and reports a real top-level location from the workspace.
prompt: You are about to plan a feature for this repository, but you have not seen its structure yet. Before writing any plan, delegate a read-only reconnaissance of the codebase to the scout sub-agent (scout_probe) so you understand the existing top-level layout. After the scout reports back, summarize the project scope: name the top-level directories and entry files you must account for in planning. Do not edit or run anything yourself; this is read-only scoping. 你必须先调用 scout_probe 子代理完成只读侦察，再基于其返回结果作答。
